Dose Titration Eligibility - Safety Review
data.description: SRC must review safety data before dose increase to 30 mg/day
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant. Dose increase proceeds unless safety concerns place participants at undue risk.

data.name: ALT Elevation - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: ALT elevation criteria triggering dose modification actions
data.text: ALT > 3x ULN: reduce dose to previous level or to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD, with repeat testing every 3-4 days. ALT > 5x ULN: temporary interruption with repeat testing every 3-4 days; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less when ALT < 3x ULN requires Medical Monitor approval. ALT > 8x ULN: permanent discontinuation.

data.name: AST Elevation - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: AST elevation criteria triggering dose modification actions
data.text: AST > 3x ULN: reduce dose to previous level or to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. AST > 5x ULN: temporary interruption. AST > 8x ULN: permanent discontinuation.

data.name: Bilirubin Elevation with Liver Injury - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: Bilirubin > 2x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3x ULN indicative of liver injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3x ULN: temporary interruption with weekly repeat testing. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN; requires approval of Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Hemoglobin Decrease - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: Hemoglobin decrease from baseline triggering dose modification
data.text: Hemoglobin > 20% decrease from baseline: reduce dose to previous level or 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD, no further dose increase until resolution. Hemoglobin > 30% decrease from baseline: temporary interruption with repeat testing every 3-4 days; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD when hemoglobin and platelets are at baseline.

data.name: Platelet Decrease - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: Platelet count decrease from baseline triggering dose modification
data.text: Platelets > 20% decrease from baseline: reduce dose to previous level or 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD, no further dose increase until resolution. Platelets > 30% decrease from baseline: temporary interruption; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD when hemoglobin and platelets are at baseline.

data.name: Neutrophil Decrease - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: Neutrophil count decrease triggering dose modification
data.text: Neutrophils > 30% decrease from baseline (when neutrophils are below reference range at baseline): reduce dose to previous level or 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD, no further dose increase until resolution. Weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening requiring dose evaluation
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or neurologic physical exam: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose modification (interruption, increase, or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data. Rationale documented and re-evaluated at next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening - Dose Modification Trigger
data.description: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening (including suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis): Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose modification based on copper control parameters. Rationale documented and re-evaluated at next study visit.

data.name: Maximum Rechallenge Limit
data.description: Maximum number of rechallenges permitted after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. Investigator in consultation with Medical Monitor may change dose and dose frequency for rechallenge participants.

data.name: Mandatory Discontinuation from Study Intervention
data.description: Conditions requiring mandatory consideration for discontinuation of study intervention
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or Investigator deems necessary.

data.name: QTcF Change - Clinically Significant Finding
data.description: Clinically significant QTcF change requiring evaluation for study continuation
data.text: If a clinically significant finding including changes from baseline in QTcF is identified after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Eligibility
data.description: Conditions under which the Outpatient Period may be extended
data.text: The Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. Additional investigational product will be provided. Actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Maintenance at 15 mg/day
data.description: Condition under which dose is not increased to 30 mg/day
data.text: Participants may remain on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study if there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk.

data.name: Negative Serum Pregnancy Test at Screening
data.description: Eligibility condition for women of childbearing potential
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Renal Function Eligibility Threshold
data.description: Renal function criterion for study eligibility
data.text: Participants in renal failure defined as end-stage renal disease on dialysis (CKD stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min are excluded.

data.name: Positive Drug Toxicology Screen Exclusion
data.description: Positive urine drug screen at screening or Day -8 leads to exclusion
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids will not be tested) excludes participant.

data.name: Positive Alcohol Breath Test Exclusion
data.description: Positive alcohol breath test at screening or Day -8 leads to exclusion
data.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day -8 excludes participant.

data.name: Adaptive Design Feature Implementation
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented at Investigator discretion
data.text: This study incorporates an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: CRU Retention During Outpatient Period
data.description: Conditions under which participant may remain in CRU during outpatient period
data.text: At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Study Completion Definition
data.description: Criteria for a participant to be considered as having completed the study
data.text: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (SoA). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Screening to Enrollment Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day -7 and assigned a participant number. Must meet all inclusion/exclusion criteria including negative serum pregnancy test for women of childbearing potential, negative urine drug screen, and negative alcohol breath test.

data.name: Enrollment to Run-in Period Transition
data.text: Following enrollment on Day -7, participants are admitted to CRU on Day -8 and initiated on copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet. Diet equilibration occurs Day -7 through Day -5; pretreatment copper/molybdenum balance measurement Day -4 through Day -1.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following Run-in Period (Day -7 through Day -1), participants begin ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day on Day 1. Chelator therapy must have been discontinued for approximately 4 days prior to Day 1. Zinc therapy must have been discontinued for minimum 21 days prior to Day 1.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from CRU on Day 9 to begin Outpatient Period. Discharge may be withheld at CRU discretion for safety or study integrity. During Outpatient Period, participants use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants return to CRU on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose); all procedures start on Day 23. If Outpatient Period was extended, participant continues Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23 regardless.

data.name: 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day Dose Titration
data.text: Dose increased from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day on Day 29 following SRC review of safety data through Day 23. Titration proceeds unless safety concerns place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on 15 mg/day for duration of study.

data.name: Inpatient Period 2 to Follow-up Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (Day 40), participants transition to: prior therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, other standard of care therapy as directed by treating physician, or continuation of ALXN1840 under preapproval access at treating physician discretion.

data.name: Follow-up to End of Study
data.text: All participants return to CRU for EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days) to complete final study procedures.

data.name: Dose Reduction - ALT > 3x ULN
data.text: ALT > 3x ULN: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution. Repeat testing every 3-4 days.

data.name: Dose Interruption - ALT > 5x ULN
data.text: ALT > 5x ULN: temporary interruption with repeat testing every 3-4 days. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less when ALT < 3x ULN; requires Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation - ALT > 8x ULN
data.text: ALT > 8x ULN: permanent discontinuation of study intervention. Participant remains in study for safety follow-up.

data.name: Dose Reduction - Hemoglobin > 20% Decrease
data.text: Hemoglobin > 20% decrease from baseline: reduce dose to previous level or 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution of abnormality.

data.name: Dose Interruption - Hemoglobin > 30% Decrease
data.text: Hemoglobin > 30% decrease from baseline: temporary interruption with repeat testing every 3-4 days. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD when hemoglobin and platelets are at baseline concentration.

data.name: Dose Reduction - Platelets > 20% Decrease
data.text: Platelets > 20% decrease from baseline: reduce dose to previous level or 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution.

data.name: Dose Interruption - Platelets > 30% Decrease
data.text: Platelets > 30% decrease from baseline: temporary interruption. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD when hemoglobin and platelets are at baseline.

data.name: Dose Reduction - Neutrophils > 30% Decrease
data.text: Neutrophils > 30% decrease from baseline (when below reference range at baseline): reduce dose to previous level or 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution. Weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Dose Interruption - Bilirubin > 2x ULN with Liver Injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3x ULN: temporary interruption with weekly repeat testing. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin below ULN; requires Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification - Neurological Worsening
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose modification (interruption, increase, or decrease) based on copper control parameters. Rationale documented and re-evaluated at next study visit.

data.name: Dose Modification - Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose modification. Rationale documented and re-evaluated at next study visit.

data.name: Mandatory Study Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: Mandatory discontinuation from study intervention for: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or at Alexion/Investigator discretion. Participant remains in study for safety follow-up.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal from Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. Early discontinuation visit should be conducted if possible.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Withdrawal
data.text: Participant considered lost to follow-up if repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted. Site must attempt contact and reschedule; minimum 3 telephone calls and certified letter before deemed lost to follow-up. Participant then considered withdrawn.

data.name: Study Site Closure
data.text: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time. Reasons include: failure of Investigator to comply with protocol/GCP; inadequate participant recruitment; discontinuation of study intervention development. Investigator may also initiate closure with reasonable cause and sufficient advance notice.

data.name: Deviation from Dose Modification Guidelines
data.text: Deviation from the dose modification guidelines must be agreed with the Alexion Medical Monitor. Investigators must notify Alexion immediately of study intervention discontinuation. Decision to discontinue should not be delayed for causality assessment.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Participant has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure in the SoA. End of study defined as date the last participant completes the last visit (EOS Visit Day 54 +/- 2 days).

data.name: Voluntary Participant Withdrawal
data.description: Participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request. Early discontinuation visit conducted if possible. Participant permanently discontinued from both study intervention and study.

data.name: Investigator-Initiated Withdrawal
data.description: Participant may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons.

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation Due to ALT > 8x ULN
data.description: ALT exceeding 8x ULN requires permanent discontinuation of study intervention. Participant remains in study for safety follow-up per SoA.

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation Due to AST > 8x ULN
data.description: AST exceeding 8x ULN requires permanent discontinuation of study intervention. Participant remains in study for safety follow-up.

data.name: Discontinuation Due to Serious Hypersensitivity Reaction
data.description: Serious hypersensitivity reaction requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention. Participant remains in study for safety follow-up.

data.name: Discontinuation Due to Severe Uncontrolled Infection
data.description: Severe uncontrolled infection requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Discontinuation Due to Use of Disallowed Medication
data.description: Use of disallowed medication requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Discontinuation Due to Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participant repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted despite minimum 3 telephone calls and certified letter. Participant considered withdrawn from study.

data.name: Study Site Closure by Alexion
data.description: Alexion may close study site or terminate study at any time for any reason at sole discretion. Reasons include protocol non-compliance, inadequate recruitment, or discontinuation of study intervention development.

data.name: Investigator-Initiated Site Closure
data.description: Investigator may initiate study-site closure at any time with reasonable cause and sufficient advance notice.

data.name: Maximum Rechallenge Limit Reached
data.description: After a maximum of 3 rechallenges, no further rechallenge is permitted. Participant management to be determined by Investigator in consultation with Medical Monitor.

data.name: SRC Safety Review for Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant before authorizing dose titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day on Day 29.

data.name: Dose Modification Assessment - ALT
data.description: At any scheduled or unscheduled visit, ALT results are assessed against dose modification thresholds (>3x, >5x, >8x ULN) to determine appropriate dose action.

data.name: Dose Modification Assessment - Hematology
data.description: At any scheduled or unscheduled visit, hemoglobin, platelet, and neutrophil results are assessed against dose modification thresholds to determine appropriate dose action.

data.name: Neurological/Psychiatric Worsening Assessment
data.description: At any visit, evidence of neurological or psychiatric worsening triggers joint evaluation by Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor for dose modification decision.

data.name: QTcF Change Evaluation
data.description: If clinically significant QTcF change identified after enrollment, Investigator determines if participant can continue in study and if management changes are needed.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: At Day 9 discharge, Investigator decides whether standard outpatient period is sufficient or extension of up to 14 additional days is warranted. Additional IP provided if extended.

data.name: CRU Retention vs Discharge Decision
data.description: At Day 9, CRU decides whether to discharge participant to outpatient period or retain in CRU for safety or study integrity reasons.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Transition Decision
data.description: Following completion of both inpatient periods on Day 40, treating physician determines whether participant transitions to prior therapy, other standard of care, or continues ALXN1840 under preapproval access.

data.name: Rechallenge Decision After Dose Interruption
data.description: After temporary dose interruption, rechallenge eligibility assessed based on laboratory parameter resolution. Maximum 3 rechallenges permitted. Medical Monitor approval required for certain rechallenge scenarios.

data.name: Copper Balance Assessment at 15 mg Steady State
data.description: Assessment of copper balance at 15 mg/day steady state using I/O collection data from Days 25-28 to characterize decoppering vs maintenance dose effect.

data.name: Copper Balance Assessment at 30 mg Accumulation
data.description: Assessment of copper balance during 30 mg/day accumulation phase using I/O collection data from Days 29-35 (specifically Days 31-35).

data.name: Copper Balance Assessment at 30 mg Steady State
data.description: Assessment of copper balance at 30 mg/day steady state using I/O collection data from Days 36-39.
